name: What factors influence the cost of shiplap installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of shiplap installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of shiplap installation varies based on several factors. The primary considerations include the type of wood or material chosen (e.g., pine, MDF, reclaimed wood), the total square footage of the area to be covered, and the complexity of the installation. For instance, covering a large, simple wall will be less labor-intensive than installing shiplap around multiple windows, doors, or intricate architectural features. Preparing the existing surface, such as removing old wallpaper or repairing drywall, also contributes to the overall project cost. We provide detailed estimates for projects in Garden City, Meridian, Eagle, and Kuna.
acceptedAnswer.description: Shiplap installation costs depend on material choice, square footage, and project complexity, including surface preparation. Intricate areas and larger spaces typically increase the overall investment.
